## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link the issue or OpenSpec change when applicable.

## Verification

List checks run, results, and any missing platform evidence. Describe security and compatibility effects. Include upgrade/release notes when needed.

## Maintainer admission

A human maintainer must post `/ready FULL_HEAD_SHA` before CI or AI runs. After review, post `/approve FULL_HEAD_SHA`. New commits need fresh decisions. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
